senses.gloss: (cmp. חלחל), (mostly) Pa. חַלֵּיל (v. preced.) [to turn in a hollow space,] to wash, rinse.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 4:6">Targ. II Chr. IV, 6</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 1:9">Targ. Lev. I, 9</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Chullin 113a:10">Ḥull. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>דחַלְּלֵי בי טבחא</he> when they washed the meat in the slaughter house.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 3:3">Targ. Ruth III, 3</cite>.—

<cite ref="Chullin 95b">Ḥull. 95ᵇ</cite> top <he>מַחְלִיל רישא וכ׳</he> (or <he>מְחַלֵּיל</he>) Ar. (ed. <cite ref="M00814"><he>מחוור</he></cite>) he was washing an animal’s head in the river, v. <cite ref="H00444"><he>חֲוַר</he></cite>
